sources.title: Priority Pass · The Lounge San Juan Terminal A

lounges.note: A separate lounge from Terminals B and C. Priority Pass currently uses a three-hour entry and stay limit; older card-provider guides show four hours. Admission can be restricted when busy.

qualityRating.summary: A March 2025 firsthand visit found cramped, worn seating and limited facilities, despite friendly reception. The reviewer did not try the ordered food, so this assessment does not judge that menu.

American Express · Terminal C food and Wi-Fi

lounges.note: Food is available, but the current service style is not verified. Priority Pass currently permits entry and a stay of up to three hours; older card-provider listings show four hours. Capacity restrictions can apply.

qualityRating.summary: The 2024 firsthand account praises friendly staff and drinks but describes dated seating, basic meals and substantial crowding at busy times. The older visit is useful context, not a current condition guarantee.

lounges.name: Escape Lounge
lounges.location: Concourse B opposite Gate B2; enter at concourse level and descend to the lounge.

accessRules.label: Eligible American Express Platinum
conditions: Confirm your Platinum card variant qualifies and show the physical card, ID and same-day boarding pass. The operator’s published Amex terms require the flight to have been booked on a US-issued Amex card; check any local-card exception directly.

accessRules.label: Delta SkyMiles Reserve on a Delta-marketed flight
conditions: Show an eligible Reserve card and confirm its booking/payment conditions; the departure must be Delta-marketed on the same day.

sources.title: Escape Lounges · San Juan location, opening and access
Escape Lounges · US entry and card conditions
Escape Lounges · San Juan hot and cold buffet menu

lounges.note: Priority Pass is not confirmed at this Escape location. Ordinary entry is within three hours of departure; the operator allows qualifying connections earlier, but the app does not infer that exception. No premium-cabin or alliance-status access is assumed.

qualityRating.summary: A July 2025 visit, published that October, enjoyed the hot lunch selection and friendly welcome. The small lounge was already at capacity, making queues and limited seating the principal tradeoffs.

sources.title: TravelUpdate · Escape San Juan firsthand review, October 2025

recommendation.summary: A buffet option for eligible Amex or Delta Reserve cardholders; allow for a wait at busy times.
